chunks: And from him, from Ayyūb ibn Nūḥ, from Aḥmad, from Muḥammad ibn Abī Ḥamzah, from ʿAlī ibn Yaqṭīn, from Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a menstruating woman who sees purity: may her husband have intercourse with her before she performs ghusl? He said: There is no harm, but after ghusl is more beloved to me.

key_terms.الطُّهْرَ: cessation of menstruation and return to purity
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for a husband to have intercourse with his wife after her menstruation ends but before she performs ghusl?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning intercourse with a woman whose menstrual bleeding has ceased before she performs ghusl. It states that it is permissible, though intercourse after ghusl is preferred.
